battle.name: 羅唐戰爭
battle.brief: 唐咸亨元年（670年）起，新羅斷絕朝貢、與唐爭奪朝鮮半島，唐安東都護府在平壤、熊津一線與新羅軍反覆拉鋸，到咸亨五年（676年）雙方才罷兵。卡面亞述長弓所代表的「弓兵在車上射、車兵靠弓兵開路」的樣式，並未隨軍東渡半島；但弓弩正是這場拉鋸的骨幹，唐軍以強弩與投石壓制城頭，新羅則以短弓配革盾與獵手，在城郊消耗唐軍前鋒。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 羅唐戰爭（朝鮮語作나당전쟁，即唐與新羅的戰爭）自唐咸亨元年（670年）起，至咸亨五年（676年）年底收束，交戰的兩方是唐王朝與新羅王國。唐朝方面由皇帝高宗李治在長安遙控，前線由行軍大將總司，最高據點是平壤的安東都護府，護府之下設都督府與州縣，編管歸附的高句麗、靺鞨、百濟餘眾；兵員由幽州、萊州等後方經遼東陸路與渤海海道運往半島，前線主將先後有李勣、契苾何力、劉仁願、高侃、郭待封、薛仁貴等，編制採行軍大將領軍、佐官分統諸道的節制方式，兵種以府兵與募兵混合的步兵為主，輔以騎兵與水軍。新羅方面以金氏王權為核心，首都金城設執事大等合議的中央機構；國王善德早前已受唐冊封，起初對唐恭順，戰事爆發後改由興法王金春秋主導應戰，地方城柵、郡縣與部落的兵源以部為編制單位，設十人將與各級將領分轄，另有高句麗、百濟降卒與義兵編入軍中。兩軍後勤體系的差距極大：唐靠山東、遼東的粟米與海船支應，戰線一退，糧道就拉長；新羅就地徵糧、以城固守，補給短而穩，這是六年消耗戰中最要命的變數。
countriesEn: The Luo-Tang war (Korean: 나당 전쟁, the war between the Tang and Silla) began in the first year of Xianheng (670) and was not wound up until the end of the fifth year of that era (676). The two parties were the Tang dynasty and the Silla kingdom. On the Tang side, Emperor Gaozong (Li Zhi) in Chang'an set the policy while the front was under generals-at-large; the highest base was the Protectorate General to Pacify the East at Pyongyang, and beneath it stood dufu offices and commanderies and counties that registered the surrendered Goguryeo, Mohe and Baekje populations. Men came from the rear at Youzhou and Laizhou by land through Liaodong and by sea across the Bohai, and the commanders in turn included Li Ji, Qibi Heli, Liu Renyuan, Gao Kan, Guo Daifeng and Xue Rengui, under the standard Tang system in which a great general led and assistants governed the several circuits. The army mixed fubing and recruited infantry, with cavalry and a river and sea force in support. On the Silla side the state was centred on the Kim monarchy; the capital at Jinshi, that is Seoul, ran the central government through a council of the jipdaedale, the executive officers, and the king was advised by the same body. King Seongdeok had been invested by the Tang as early as 636 and was at first deferential, but once the war broke out the kingdom was run under King Xingfa, Kim Chunchu; the walled towns, commanderies and tribal districts of the peninsula supplied the men, the units were organised by departments with officers of the party of ten and other grades above them, and men who had surrendered from Goguryeo and Baekje, together with irregulars, were folded into the Silla ranks. The difference between the two systems of supply was extreme. The Tang drew millet from Shandong and Liaodong and carried it by sea, so every withdrawal of the line lengthened the grain road; Silla levied grain on the spot and sat behind its own walls, which kept its supply short but steady, and that was the single most damaging variable in a war of six years' attrition.
people: 羅唐戰爭的關鍵人物分屬兩營。新羅一方以王權為軸：善德王早於636年受唐冊封，起初對唐恭順，直到六七十年代面對高句麗、靺鞨、百濟歸附勢力湧入半島，才轉為強硬；開戰後由興法王金春秋執掌朝政，執事大等分掌外交、兵糧與州縣，前線將領以朴市田來札等部將統兵，此人於熊津一線與唐將薛仁貴交鋒，其後新羅又調兵北上配合唐軍，最後再由新羅一方主動請和收場。唐一方，最高決策在高宗李治，咸亨四年（673年）前後高宗曾打算趁新羅疲憊增兵再戰，廷上議而未決、遷延戰機，兵敗之後又改變主意。名將薛仁貴最為人知，他於676年在熊津反敗為勝、破新羅軍。與他同時的將領各有咎有功：契苾何力早年平定高句麗、百濟餘眾，劉仁願在熊津一線慘敗後被貶，高侃有戰功，薛仁貴屢請增兵糧而不得，益州司馬郭待封在拜伊城遲誤戰機、遭貶為庶人。此外，百濟遺臣泉男生與高句麗貴族乞伏黎於669至670年間起兵反唐，兵眾二十餘萬，兵敗之後泉男生奔新羅求助，成為新羅出兵的名義與兵源。
peopleEn: The key figures of the war fall into two camps. On the Silla side the axis was the kingship. King Seongdeok was invested by the Tang as early as 636 and at first deferential, but in the late 660s and early 670s, with the surrendered Goguryeo, Mohe and Baekje populations pouring into the peninsula, he turned hard. Once the war began, King Xingfa, Kim Chunchu, took charge of the state, the jipdaedale dividing foreign affairs, supply and the provincial administrations, and field commanders such as Park Si-cheon-rae-chal led the troops; that officer met Xue Rengui of the Tang on the Yongsan front, and Silla later again sent troops north to operate alongside the Tang, and in the end it was Silla that sued for peace and closed the war. On the Tang side the highest decisions belonged to Gaozong; around the fourth year of Xianheng (673) he planned to reinforce and fight again while Silla was exhausted, but the matter was debated in court and deferred, the opportunity faded, and the mind changed again after the defeats. The best known general was Xue Rengui, who reversed the verdict at Yongsan in 676 and broke the Silla army. His colleagues had mixed records. Qibi Heli had earlier crushed the rising of the Goguryeo and Baekje remnants; Liu Renyuan was demoted after the disaster on the Yongsan front; Gao Kan earned credit; Xue Rengui asked again and again for more men and more grain and was not given them; and Guo Daifeng, governor of Yizhou, lost time at Baeyi and was stripped of his office and reduced to commoner status. A further set of actors came from the defeated states: the Baekje exile Baek Nam-seong (泉男生) and the Goguryeo noble Qifu Li (乞伏黎) raised a revolt against the Tang between 669 and 670 with more than two hundred thousand men; when that rising was crushed, Baek Nam-seong fled to Silla and asked for help, and so gave Silla both the pretext and the men for its intervention.
kits: 本卡兵器是亞述長弓（Assyrian bow）：兩河流域早期鐵器時代的複合弓，角胎或木胎，附短弓箍與金屬配件，箭為木杆鐵鏃，亞述人把它與鐵斧、投石與撞槌綁在一起，靠「弓兵在車上射、車兵靠弓兵開路」的組合，逐城逐谷地征服兩河。必須說明的是，這件兵器並未隨軍東渡七世紀的朝鮮半島；但弓在體系裡的位置，在半島戰役中同樣是骨幹。唐軍的遠射力量以弓與弩為主，直腰弩、擲石機一類器械在攻城時才用，攻城同時靠雲梯、巢車、撞車與飛石，糧食以粟米由山東登萊裝船，渡海在熊津登陸再轉陸路運到平壤；新羅一方以短弓與弩為主，弓手多出身獵戶，弓與革盾、短刀相配，七世紀新羅冶鐵業已相當發達，弓弩部件與鐵鏃供應不困難。比較兩軍，真正拉開差距的並非弓的形制，而是唐軍的強弩與投石能夠壓制城頭，而新羅的弓兵更善於在山林與城邑之間的短射程內周旋。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Assyrian bow: a composite bow of the early iron age in Mesopotamia, horn or wood belly, with a short bow grip and metal fittings, its arrows with wooden shafts and iron points. The Assyrians bound it together with iron axes, stone throwers and rams, and conquered the two rivers valley by valley with the combination of archers shooting from the chariots and chariot crews following behind the archers' fire. It has to be said that this weapon never crossed to the seventh-century Korean peninsula with any army; yet the place of the bow in the order of battle on the peninsula was just as central. The Tang shooting strength rested on bows and crossbows, with the zhuiyao crossbow and the throwing stone engine coming into their own only for siege; siege likewise relied on scaling ladders, siege towers, battering rams and stone throwers, and the grain was millet, loaded at Dengzhou and Lai-chou in Shandong, carried across the sea and landed at Yongsan, then moved overland to Pyongyang. Silla's shooting strength was short bows and crossbows, its archers mostly drawn from hunting households, the bow paired with the hide shield and the short knife; Silla's iron industry was well developed by the seventh century, so the parts of bows and crossbows and the iron points were never in short supply. Compared between the two armies, what really separated them was not the form of the bow but the Tang heavy crossbows and stone throwers, which could pin down the wall, while Silla's archers were better at moving in short range among the hills and inside the towns.
tactics: 兩軍的戰術差異，在於一方善攻城、一方善守土。668年唐軍滅高句麗時造飛雲梯與巢車，十餘丈的攻城塔貼在安市城的山壁上，士卒緣梯而上，一舉破城；羅唐戰爭卻是在唐軍失去主動攻城能力之後才開始的。唐軍在半島上以據點線作戰：平壤、熊津、漢江下游的城邑串成一條南北線，遠程以投石機、弓弩消耗敵陣，近距離以長矛方陣配合騎兵衝擊，騎兵多作追擊與側擊之用；水軍沿西海與渤海巡弋，掩護糧船。問題出在補給：平壤距後方幽州千里上下，糧秣靠海運轉陸運，任何一場敗仗都會把這條線拉得更長。新羅的戰法是守城與消耗：以城郭、砦堡節節抵抗，退入太白山脈的隘道，利用山地切割唐軍縱隊，切斷糧道，再以弓兵與長矛兵在城郊消耗唐軍前鋒，待其銳氣與糧秣俱竭才反擊。676年熊津之戰即是此法的成敗關鍵：唐軍雖在名將率領下取得一場勝利，卻因遠征而無法追擊到底。
tacticsEn: The contrast in tactics was between a side good at besieging and a side good at holding ground. When the Tang destroyed Goguryeo in 668 they built scaling ladders and siege towers, a tower of more than ten zhang pressed against the hillside above Anshi city, and the soldiers climbed it and took the city in a single stroke; the Luo-Tang war, however, began at the moment the Tang had lost the ability to attack on their own initiative. On the peninsula the Tang fought along a chain of strongpoints: Pyongyang, Yongsan and the towns of the lower Han river, tied into one north-south line. At range they wore the enemy down with stone-throwers, bows and crossbows; at close range they combined the spear square with cavalry charges, the horse being used mostly for pursuit and for the flanking blow. Their navy patrolled the western sea and the Bohai route, escorting the grain boats. The difficulty lay in supply: Pyongyang stood some thousand li from Youzhou in the rear, the grain moved by sea and then by land, so that every defeat stretched that line further. Silla fought by holding and by attrition. The walled towns and stockades were defended in turn, and the army withdrew into the passes of the Paektu range, letting the mountains cut the Tang columns and close the supply road, and then bowmen and spearmen outside the walls ground down the Tang vanguard until its momentum and its grain were both spent. The battle of Yongsan in 676 was the test of that method: the Tang won a battle under a famous general, but could not follow it through, because a distant expedition could not be supplied.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但大框架清楚。時間上，戰爭自唐咸亨元年（670年）起，到咸亨五年（676年）九月熊津再戰、十二月罷安東都護府，前後約六年，新羅於次年受封帶方郡王。地理上，平壤在北緯三十九度零二分、東經一百二十五度四十五分，熊津在今黃海道一帶，與平壤直線距離約二百五十至三百公里，金城（漢城）在平壤西南約二百公里；唐後方幽州距平壤超過一千公里，山東登萊到熊津的海程約七百海里。兵力方面，唐初對高句麗作戰投入的總兵數，歷代史家估計自二十餘萬至四十餘萬不等，羅唐戰爭中唐軍前沿常備兵力當在數萬量級；高句麗復國運動則有二十餘萬之記錄，契苾何力破之，斬首萬級、溺死者數萬。新羅方面，執事大等調度的城兵與降卒合計亦以萬計。損失方面，670年代前期唐軍在熊津一線的敗仗中，統將僅以身免、士卒折損過半；676年薛仁貴在熊津破新羅軍，新羅的損兵數只有推測而無確數。土地方面，統一後的新羅統治範圍約二十萬平方公里，人口估計在百萬上下。
dataEn: Few figures survive that can be checked, but the broad frame is clear. In time, the war ran from the first year of Xianheng (670) to the renewed fighting at Yongsan in the ninth month of the fifth year (676) and the abolition of the Protectorate General to Pacify the East in the twelfth month, about six years in all, and Silla was invested as ruler of the Jibang commandery the following year. In geography, Pyongyang lies at 39.02 degrees north and 125.75 degrees east; Yongsan lies in what is now the Hwanghae region, roughly two hundred and fifty to three hundred kilometres in a straight line from Pyongyang; Jinshi, that is Seoul, lies some two hundred kilometres to the south-west of Pyongyang; Youzhou in the rear is more than a thousand kilometres from Pyongyang; and the sea run from Dengzhou in Shandong to Yongsan is about seven hundred nautical miles. On troops, the totals raised against Goguryeo in the opening years of the Tang have been estimated by historians at anywhere from two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand, and the Tang frontier force in the Luo-Tang war must likewise have been numbered in the tens of thousands; the Goguryeo restoration rising, on the other hand, is recorded with more than two hundred thousand men and was broken by Qibi Heli at a cost of ten thousand dead by the sword and several thousand drowned. On the Silla side, the garrisons of the cities and the surrendered men that the jipdaedale could draw on were likewise counted in thousands. On losses, in the Tang defeats of the early 670s on the Yongsan front the commanders escaped with a few followers and more than half the soldiers were lost; in 676 Xue Rengui broke the Silla army at Yongsan, and how many Silla men died is a matter of estimate rather than record. On territory, the unified Silla governed about two hundred thousand square kilometres, with a population estimated in the region of a million.
cause: 羅唐戰爭的起因有四層。最底層是半島的權力格局：六六〇年代新羅已滅百濟、兼併高句麗南部，統一大半個朝鮮半島；六六八年唐滅高句麗，設安東都護府於平壤，設郡縣、編戶籍、招撫歸附，並以護府名義治理整個半島，雙方都想獨佔這份權力。第二層是唐的宗主國要求與新羅的自主意願正面相撞：唐要求新羅受冊封、接受護府管轄、協助鎮壓高句麗與百濟餘眾，新羅則認為自己已完成統一，而高句麗復國運動恰好有助清除唐的據點。第三層是歸附人口的安置難題：大批高句麗、百濟人口被內遷或編入新羅郡縣，地方抵抗因此有了溫床。第四層是直接的導火線——六六九至六七〇年間高句麗遺民推乞伏黎、百濟遺臣泉男生起兵反唐，兵眾二十餘萬，連破唐軍據點；新羅藉「協助平叛」出兵接手其地，唐軍由平壤南撤，戰爭自此全面爆發。
causeEn: The war had four layers of cause. The deepest was the distribution of power on the peninsula. By the 660s Silla had destroyed Baekje, absorbed southern Goguryeo and unified most of the Korean peninsula; in 668 the Tang destroyed Goguryeo, set up the Protectorate General to Pacify the East at Pyongyang, created commanderies and counties, registered households, took in the surrendered, and governed the whole peninsula in the name of that office. Both sides wanted the sole right to dispose of it. The second layer was the collision between Tang claims of overlordship and Silla's own sense of sovereignty: the Tang required Silla to accept investiture, to be governed by the protectorate and to help suppress the Goguryeo and Baekje remnants, while Silla held that it had already completed unification, and that the restoration movement among the Goguryeo clans worked in its favour by clearing out Tang footholds. The third layer was the impossibility of settling the surrendered populations. Large numbers of Goguryeo and Baekje people were moved inland or folded into Silla commanderies, and that became fertile ground for local resistance. The fourth layer was the immediate spark. Between 669 and 670 the surviving Goguryeo raised Qifu Li as king and the Baekje exile Baek Nam-seong as their leader, more than two hundred thousand men, and they broke Tang outposts; Silla came in under the pretext of helping to put the rising down, took over the ground, and as the Tang withdrew south from Pyongyang the war became general.
impact: 羅唐戰爭的結果重塑了東北亞。對新羅而言，藉清除高句麗、百濟殘部並逐走唐軍，新羅在676年後完成半島統一，681年前後頒布統一新羅的行政措施，統一三韓的格局由此定型，並在此後數百年維持，直到738年新羅再統一半島、與渤海對峙。對唐而言，這是一場結構性失敗：安東都護府在676年12月撤銷，唐軍退出半島，但唐廷把護府降格、遷治幽州，改設安東都護，把經略重心移向遼東與北方草原，這條政策最終釀成692至698年的唐渤海戰爭與渤海建國，羅唐關係隨之惡化。技術上，新羅在戰中吸收唐的冶鐵、鑄造與馬具技術，冶鐵業成為新羅的支柱產業，鐵製品大量輸往日本，形成東亞知名的鐵器市場。制度上，新羅借戰爭集權，執事大等分割王權的格局被打破，國王直轄六部與州縣，國家結構由此定型。
impactEn: The outcome of the Luo-Tang war reshaped northeast Asia. For Silla, clearing away the Goguryeo and Baekje remnants and driving out the Tang completed the unification of the peninsula; the administrative measures of the unified Silla were promulgated around 681, the shape of a united Three Han was thereby fixed, and it held for the centuries that followed, until Silla unified the peninsula again in 738 in the face of Balhae. For the Tang this was a structural failure. The protectorate was abolished in the twelfth month of 676 and the troops and officials left the peninsula, but the court degraded the office, moved it to Youzhou and created a lesser An Dong Duhu instead, shifting the centre of policy towards Liaodong and the northern steppe; that policy produced in the end the Tang-Balhae war of 692 to 698 and the founding of Balhae, and Luo-Tang relations soured accordingly. In technical terms Silla absorbed Tang ironworking, casting and harness technology during the war; the iron industry became a pillar of the Silla economy, and Silla iron went out in quantity to Japan, forming the East Asian market in iron goods. Institutionally the war let the monarchy centralise: the arrangement by which the jipdaedale shared the king's power was broken, the king administered the six ministries and the commanderies directly, and the structure of the state was thereby settled.
result: 羅唐戰爭以唐軍退出朝鮮半島、新羅完成統一收場，但兩邊都付了代價。過程上，670年代前期唐軍在平壤、熊津一線連敗，統將僅以身免，士卒折損過半，平壤等城邑相繼失守；新羅雖勝，卻把主力消耗在攻城與遠征上，國內兵源與糧食同樣吃緊。676年薛仁貴在熊津反敗為勝、破新羅軍，新羅不得不在同一年請和，放棄把戰事推向唐軍殘部與新佔區的打算。收束上，676年12月唐廷下詔罷安東都護府，平壤等地的唐軍與官吏撤出，兩國邊界大致以大同江為界，新羅取得大同江以南的實控；677年唐冊封新羅王為帶方郡王，以名號換取和平。勝負之外是結構性的判斷：唐軍在半島上缺乏足夠的援軍與持久的補給線，新羅則能以本土城池消耗遠征軍隊——這條關於遠征的教訓，後來被唐廷用於處理北方草原與西域問題，而新羅的守城經驗，則成為統一新羅抵禦渤海與應對唐代使節的基礎。
resultEn: The Luo-Tang war ended with the Tang army leaving the Korean peninsula and Silla completing the unification of it, but both sides paid for it. In the course of events, the Tang lost Pyongyang and the Yongsan line in succession in the early 670s; the commanders escaped with a few followers, more than half the soldiers were lost, and strongholds including Pyongyang fell in turn. Silla won, but it had spent its strength on sieges and on long marches, and recruitment and grain inside the kingdom were strained in turn. In 676 Xue Rengui reversed the verdict at Yongsan and broke the Silla army, so that Silla had to sue for peace in the same year and give up the plan of carrying the war to the Tang remnants and to the ground it had taken. The closing moves were these: in the twelfth month of 676 the Tang court issued the edict abolishing the Protectorate General to Pacify the East, the troops and officials of Pyongyang and the other garrisons withdrew, and the boundary between the two states came to rest roughly along the Taedong river, with Silla holding the ground south of it; in 677 the Tang invested the Silla king as ruler of the Jibang commandery, buying peace with a title. Beyond the score sheet lies the structural verdict. The Tang army on the peninsula lacked the reinforcements and the durable supply line it needed, while Silla could use its own cities to exhaust an expeditionary army; that lesson about overland expedition was read by the Tang court afterwards in its handling of the northern steppe and the western regions, and the defensive experience it taught Silla became the basis on which the unified Silla later faced Balhae and the envoys of the Tang.
